description: Opportunity report produced by the model before the decision: an optional boundary flag and up to three scored conversation starters. Limited to features common structured-output engines support; scripts/validate.py also enforces at most 3 candidates, unique ids and topics, evidence ids present in the context, no repetition of recent proactive messages, and the message style rules.

note.description: What the user asked for or said, in one sentence.

evidence.description: Ids of the messages that set the boundary.

boundary.description: Set when the user asked for a break or is unavailable right now; then candidates should be empty.

candidates.description: Up to three conversation starters, each on a different topic.

topic.description: Short topic label, used for diversity and repetition checks.

message.description: The opening message, ready to send.

rationale.description: Why this, why now, in one sentence.

evidence.description: Context ids the candidate is grounded in.
